create.name: Sarah Blondin
create.bio:
Sarah Blondin is a Canadian writer and meditation guide whose teaching rests on one idea: that turning towards the heart, rather than away from difficult feelings, is how we come back to ourselves. She began by writing, filming and narrating Live Awake, a series of short reflective films and podcast episodes that each close with a brief guided meditation. Those recordings found a wide audience, and since 2016 she has been one of the most followed teachers on Insight Timer.

Her style is lyrical and personal. She draws on poetry, stories from motherhood and her own inner life, and invites listeners to soften, slow down and meet themselves with compassion. Her book Heart Minded (Sounds True, 2020) gathers these teachings into reflections and practices for living from the heart. She offers two ten-day audio courses (Coming Home to Yourself, then This Deepest Self), shorter recorded workshops, an annual membership with her growing archive, and occasional live online sessions and retreats in British Columbia, where she lives with her husband and two sons.

books.title: Heart Minded: How to Hold Yourself and Others in Love
books.author: Sarah Blondin
books.description: Short reflections and guided practices on dropping out of the busy, critical mind and resting in the heart. Readers also get access to companion audio meditations narrated by Blondin.

courses.title: All-Access Annual Subscription
courses.description: A yearly membership opening up her growing online archive of courses, recorded workshops and audio sessions. New material is added through the year.

courses.title: This Deepest Self
courses.description: A ten-day audio course in which each day is a stand-alone contemplation and meditation. It focuses on meeting whatever arises with steady, kind awareness. Also available inside Insight Timer.

courses.title: Coming Home To Yourself
courses.description: A ten-day audio course on turning inwards with care for body, mind and heart, easing the fear of exploring one's inner life. Also available inside Insight Timer.

courses.title: Making Your Life Sacred Workshop
courses.description: A recorded 90-minute group workshop with conversation and guided meditation. The theme is treating your own life, and yourself, as something precious.

courses.title: Living From The Heart Workshop
courses.description: Two recorded one-hour sessions on accepting yourself without judgement and moving attention from the thinking mind to the feeling heart.

free_resources.title: Sarah Blondin on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer page carries dozens of her lyrical guided meditations and reflective talks on self-compassion, letting go and living from the heart. The tracks are free to play in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Live Awake Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free, ad-free podcast of spoken reflections on themes such as change, fear and surrender. Each episode ends with a short guided meditation on its topic.
